# Reconstructing the Rio Favela 2.5D Scene from Free Earth-Observation Data — Integrated Staged Plan

## 1. Problem statement & honest accuracy ceiling

**Goal.** Reconstruct a 2.5D scene — bare-earth DTM + building footprints + per-building height — over five dense, steep, self-built Rio favelas (Rocinha, Vidigal, Maré, Complexo do Alemão, Jacarezinho) using **only free, online, ideally-redistributable** satellite/EO data, then score it against the held-out IPP ground truth (5 m DTM, 2.36 M footprints with `altura`, `tipo` A101/A102, EPSG:31983, ~2019). The IPP data is the **test set only** and never enters the reconstruction.

**The honest ceiling.** No free EO product resolves the thing that defines these sites: individual 5–10 m self-built rooftops on 20–50% granite slopes. Every viable path converges on the *same* three global products (Open Buildings v3 footprints, Open Buildings 2.5D-Temporal 2019 heights, a 30 m global DEM), because the alternatives — SAR per-building height regression and free-VHR shadow inversion — have no valid input over these favelas. Therefore the realistic outcome is:

- **DTM:** the strongest component but resolution-capped. Favela RMSE ~4–8 m (up to ~8–10 m on >25° slopes), positive bias +1–3 m in dense cores from incomplete ML building-removal; 30 m posting cannot reproduce alley/stair micro-relief that the IPP 5 m DTM captures.
- **Heights:** exact 2019 vintage, respectable in aggregate (100 m grid-mean R² ~0.5–0.7) but weak per-building (MAE ~2–4 m, R² ~0.2–0.4) with low-rise regression-to-mean and tall-building saturation (4 m effective Sentinel-2).
- **Footprints:** good built-up *area* coverage (area-IoU ~0.45–0.6) but severe *instance* under-segmentation in dense fabric (instance-F1 ~0.35–0.55, building count far below IPP's 2.36 M).

The deliverable's credibility rests not on beating these numbers — they are physical limits of free data — but on **measuring and reporting them honestly**, per-site, per-stratum, with leakage quarantined.

## 2. Ranked comparison of candidate approaches

| # | Approach | Feasibility | DTM | Footprints | Heights | License clean? | Coverage | 2019 match |
|---|----------|:-----------:|-----|-----------|---------|:--------------:|:--------:|:----------:|
| **1** | **Zero-shot global-product fusion + support-matched stratified spatial CV** *(recommended)* | **8.5** | OK (borrowed 30 m) | Area good / instance weak | Aggregate good / per-bldg weak | ✅ (GLO-30 path) | ✅ | ✅ heights exact |
| 2 | Consume-the-product fusion (OB v3 + 2.5D-2019 draped on GLO-30/FABDEM) | 8.0 | OK (borrowed) | Area good / instance weak | Aggregate good | ✅ (GLO-30 path) | ✅ | ✅ heights exact |
| 3 | Bare-earth-first: FathomDEM DTM ⊖ GLO-30 DSM + OB vectors/2.5D | 7.5 | **Best free DTM** (FathomDEM SOTA) but NC | borrowed / weak | aggregate | ⚠️ NC-only (FathomDEM CC-BY-NC-SA) | ✅ | ✅ heights exact |
| 4 | Tiered fusion with nDSM differencing as aggregate bias-constraint | 7.0 | Good (FABDEM) | borrowed / weak | per-bldg from OB; nDSM anchor only | ❌ (FABDEM NC; self-declared) | ✅ | ⚠️ mixed (DSM 2011–15) |
| 5 | Free radar 2.5D stack (FABDEM DTM + GLO-30 DSM + S1 backscatter/coherence height regressor) | 4.5 | Good DTM backbone | ❌ **none** (raster mask only) | ❌ coarse/aspirational | ❌ (FABDEM NC) | ✅ | ✅ S1/S2 exact-2019 |
| 6 | Optical + shadow-height refinement (OB 2.5D backbone + VHR shadow anchor) | 4.0 | ❌ (optical can't) | area good | signature module inoperable | ⚠️ backbone OK | ❌ no free VHR over sites | ❌ VHR = 2022 events |

**Why the top three cluster and #1 wins.** #1, #2, #3 share the identical redistributable data spine and all clear the free+online+redistributable+Rio+2019 gate; they differ in DTM choice and evaluation rigor, not raw capability. #1 wins because it wraps that spine in the only defensible *evaluation contract* (test-set quarantine, correspondence-free supports, favela stratification, vintage-change proxy). **#5 and #6 fail at the input layer**: SAR C-band (~14–20 m effective) never resolves favela roofs and its InSAR phase-to-height is dead on decorrelated steep vegetation; free VHR for shadow inversion does not exist over these five favelas at 2019 (Maxar Open Data = unrelated 2022 flood events; NICFI = non-redistributable, 4.6 m, discontinued Jan-2025).

## 3. Recommended primary pipeline

**Design principle:** *consume published global products zero-shot, fuse them into an IPP-schema scene, and score under a hard leakage quarantine.* No model training, no scarce imagery, reproducible from Google Earth Engine in hours and portable to all 1,074 favela polygons.

### 3.1 Datasets (all verified free/online; license stated honestly)

| Role | Dataset | Resolution | License | Access |
|------|---------|-----------|---------|--------|
| **Footprints** | Google Open Buildings **v3** polygons | vector, from ~0.5 m imagery, confidence-scored, May-2023 inference | CC-BY-4.0 **or** ODbL 1.0 | GEE `GOOGLE/Research/open-buildings/v3/polygons`; GCS; VIDA/source.coop GeoParquet mirror |
| **Heights** | Google Open Buildings **2.5D Temporal V1**, 2019 annual slice | ~4 m effective (0.5 m grid); `building_height/presence/count` | CC-BY-4.0 / ODbL | GEE `GOOGLE/Research/open-buildings-temporal/v1`; GCS; HDX |
| **DTM (redistributable variant)** | **Copernicus GLO-30** | 30 m DSM | Free & open incl. commercial, attribution (Brazil not excluded) | AWS `copernicus-dem-30m`; OpenTopography; GEE `COPERNICUS/DEM/GLO30` |
| **DTM (best-quality, NC variant)** | **FABDEM v1.2** primary / **FathomDEM v1.0** SOTA cross-check | 30 m bare-earth | **CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0** (non-commercial + share-alike) | data.bris; Zenodo (FathomDEM `10.5281/zenodo.14523356`); GEE community catalog |
| **Height cross-check (indep.)** | GHS-BUILT-H R2023A (ANBH) | 100 m, 2018 | CC-BY-4.0 | JRC GHSL; GEE `JRC/GHSL/P2023A/GHS_BUILT_H` |
| **Height cross-check (indep.)** | WSF-3D | 90 m, ~2019 | CC-BY-4.0 | DLR EOC Geoservice |
| **Ancillary / vintage proxy** | Sentinel-2 L2A + Sentinel-1 GRD, calendar-2019 | 10 m / 10–20 m | Copernicus open | Copernicus Data Space; AWS; GEE |

**License decision — ship two variants.** The default deliverable is the **fully-redistributable CC-BY variant** (GLO-30 as DTM proxy; OB v3 + 2.5D only). A **research/NC variant** swaps in FABDEM/FathomDEM as DTM for materially better bare-earth accuracy but inherits CC-BY-NC-SA share-alike. Report both DTM lines side by side so the accuracy cost of the clean license is explicit.

### 3.2 Pipeline steps

1. **Quarantine the test set first.** Register `DTM_RJ.tif`, `buildings_RJ_2019.shp`, `Favelas_Limit_2019.shp` in a SHA manifest readable **only** by the scoring harness. No reconstruction stage may open those paths — a hard file-access boundary, not a convention.
2. **Ingest** OB v3 polygons (keep confidence as an attribute, low cut ~0.5–0.65, do not hard-threshold), OB 2.5D 2019 height raster, and the DTM (GLO-30 default; FABDEM/FathomDEM for the NC variant). Reproject all to **EPSG:31983**, clip to `Favelas_Limit_2019` + a terrain buffer.
3. **Per-building height** = zonal median (plus p90 for pitched-roof QA) of the 2019 2.5D raster inside each footprint → the `altura` analogue.
4. **Assemble the scene:** DTM raster; `base_elev` = DTM sampled at footprint centroid; `roof_elev` = base + height; extrude to LoD1 prisms. Export GPKG mirroring the IPP schema.
5. **Cross-check heights** against GHS-BUILT-H (100 m) and WSF-3D (90 m) per favela — *diagnostics only*, never fused into the shipped zero-shot number (fusing them is a calibration temptation; keep them as agreement plots).
6. **Vintage proxy:** derive a 2019-vs-2023 built-up change layer from the 2.5D-temporal presence-band delta; flag changed cells so footprint-vintage error is separable at scoring time.

### 3.3 Explicit fallbacks

- **DTM too biased in dense cores** → run FathomDEM as the primary bare-earth (NC variant) and report the diagnostic *inside-favela-minus-open-ground* bias to quantify residual roof contamination; if both fail on the steepest morros, flag those cells low-confidence rather than substitute silently.
- **OB v3 under-segments a site badly** → do **not** merge Microsoft ML footprints into the shipped product (ODbL share-alike contaminates CC-BY); use them **only** as a recall QA overlay. Keep instance metrics honest instead of patching geometry.
- **A site has no clean 1:1 footprint matches** → per-building height reverts to a flagged favorable subsample; headline shifts entirely to area/grid supports.
- **Optional nDSM anchor** (`GLO-30 DSM − FABDEM DTM`) is retained *only* as a coarse aggregate sanity layer, never per-building (30 m intra-cell terrain drop on steep slopes exceeds rooftop height → per-building differencing is noise).

## 4. Trivial baselines every component must beat

| Component | Baseline (zero effort) | Purpose |
|-----------|------------------------|---------|
| DTM | Raw GLO-30 as DTM (no bare-earthing) | fully-open floor |
| DTM | GLO-30 DSM directly as DTM (DSM-as-DTM null) | tests whether bare-earthing helps at all over favelas |
| DTM | FABDEM / FathomDEM as-is | incumbent + SOTA free-DTM baselines |
| DTM | Flat mean-plane (one elevation per favela) | quantifies how much score is just "knowing the mean elevation" |
| Footprints | OB v3 as-is | any footprint method must beat consuming the product unmodified |
| Footprints | Microsoft ML footprints; OSM buildings | two extra free footprint references |
| Heights | OB 2.5D-2019 zonal-median on OB v3, zero calibration | the turnkey product baseline |
| Heights | Constant favela-median (and global-median) `altura` | regression-to-mean lower bound |
| Heights | nDSM (GLO-30 − FABDEM) zonal-median | "free-radar-only" height null; shows whether 4 m optical adds per-building signal |
| Heights | GHS-BUILT-H (100 m); WSF-3D (90 m) | coarse aggregate-height baselines |

The recommended pipeline **is** essentially the zero-shot product baseline; its contribution is the honest measurement harness, so these baselines double as both floor and the reported result.

---

## 5. Evaluation protocol against the IPP test set

### 5.1 Metrics per component (three spatial supports)

**DTM** — RMSE, MAE, mean signed error, LE90/LE95, scored on **two supports**: (a) candidate-native posting (average IPP 5 m cells within each 30 m cell — fair to a coarse product); (b) IPP 5 m via bilinear (penalizes coarseness). The **(b)−(a) gap = pure resolution/smoothing penalty**. Plus: slope-stratified error in 0–10°/10–25°/>25° bins (slope from IPP DTM); **residual built-up bias** = signed error inside favela footprints minus on open/road pixels (diagnoses ML building-removal failure); micro-relief fidelity via Spearman of TRI/hillshade at 5 m. Any recovered vertical datum shift is fit **only on CV-train folds** (a free datum offset is calibration, not skill).

**Footprints** — (1) **area/raster support (primary, correspondence-free):** rasterize both to 5 m built masks → precision/recall/F1/pixel-IoU; (2) **instance support:** Hungarian 1:1 match at IoU≥0.5 → instance P/R/F1, building-count ratio, over-merge factor. The **area-IoU minus instance-F1 gap IS the under-segmentation metric — report it, never average it away**; (3) boundary-F1 / Chamfer on matched instances + footprint-area size-distribution divergence (KS/EMD) to expose blob-merging.

**Heights** — per-building MAE/RMSE/bias/R²/Spearman **only on clean IoU≥0.5 matches** (labelled a favorable subsample), computed as `roof_elev − IPP_DTM` so a bad borrowed DTM does not contaminate the height score (IPP ground used *only* in scoring). Plus a **height-stratified bias curve** (<6/6–9/9–15/>15 m bins) exposing low-rise regression-to-mean and tall-building saturation; and **correspondence-free aggregates** — grid mean-height MAE/R² at 100 m and 30 m + built-**volume** (Σ area·h) error, the quantity roughness/CFD actually consume.

**Composite** — per-cell roof-elevation surface RMSE (candidate vs IPP-rasterized roof) at 5 m and 30 m, tying DTM+footprint+height into one scene-level number so a method can't win one component by degrading another.

### 5.2 Spatial cross-validation

Spatially-blocked **leave-one-favela-out**: the five sites are disjoint outer folds; formal-Rio blocks add strata folds. Any tunable (OB confidence cut, zonal statistic, height-bias offset, datum shift, slope-dependent correction) is fit **only on train folds, reported only on held-out**. Nested CV (inner picks hyperparameters, outer reports). Insert a buffer ≥ the residual spatial-autocorrelation range between train and test blocks. Report per-fold distributions with fold-level CIs — a method that wins on four morros and collapses on Alemão must be visible. Zero-shot products (no tuning) are scored directly on every fold and are honest by construction.

### 5.3 Leakage guards

Hard file-access quarantine (§3.2-1) plus explicit blocks on: **calibration-as-leakage** (global offsets/datum shifts only on disjoint CV folds), **threshold selection** (confidence cuts on train folds), the **instance-correspondence trap** (per-building metrics only on IoU≥0.5 matches, flagged; area/grid carry the headline), **DTM/height entanglement** (score height against IPP ground so a borrowed DEM's error isn't laundered in), and a **training-provenance disclosure** (OB/FABDEM ingest Sentinel-2/Maxar over Rio → partially in-distribution; imagery-not-labels is allowed but must be disclosed, and no generalization claim without a truly held-out favela outside the five).

### 5.4 Stratification (formal vs favela)

**Headline metrics are A102 (favela) ONLY, per named site.** Pooled A101+A102 headlines are **forbidden** — abundant well-behaved formal fabric hides favela failure. A101 (formal) is a secondary contrast column showing the informal-vs-formal skill gap. Every metric is cross-stratified by slope bin, plan-area density λp (exposes dense-core under-segmentation), and height bin. Deliverable = a per-site × per-component × per-stratum table; a single blended score is disallowed.

### 5.5 Vintage handling

Component-specific. **Heights:** mandate the 2.5D-Temporal **2019** annual slice; S1/S2 covariates acquired for calendar-2019. **Footprints:** OB v3 is May-2023 (~4 yr gap during rapid favela churn) → report every footprint metric **with and without** change-flagged cells so real change is separated from method error. **DTM:** terrain quasi-static, so the 2011–2015 TanDEM-X epoch is acceptable, but favela vertical growth 2015→2019 biases any nDSM/DSM-derived height low — flag densified cells and down-weight nDSM there. Deliver a per-component vintage-confound sensitivity line (error-from-change vs error-from-method). Anything not pinnable to 2019 (e.g. Maxar 2022 floods) is scored **unavailable**, never substituted silently.

## 6. Staged milestone plan (prototype on ONE favela, then scale)

**Choose Rocinha as the pilot** — largest, steepest, densest, best-studied; if the pipeline survives Rocinha it survives the rest.

| Stage | Scope | Deliverable | Go / no-go gate |
|-------|-------|-------------|-----------------|
| **S0 — Harness & quarantine** | Test-set SHA manifest, scoring harness, three supports, baselines wired | Reproducible scorer + baseline table on Rocinha | **GO** if quarantine is enforced (reconstruction cannot read IPP paths) and all §4 baselines score. No-go: any leakage path open. |
| **S1 — Zero-shot scene, Rocinha** | Ingest OB v3 + 2.5D-2019 + GLO-30; assemble IPP-schema GPKG | 2.5D scene + full per-component/per-stratum card | **GO** if the scene beats the flat-plane DTM null, the constant-height null, and OB-v3-as-is footprints on ≥2 of 3 supports. No-go: cannot beat trivial nulls → rethink data spine. |
| **S2 — DTM variant bake-off** | GLO-30 vs FABDEM vs FathomDEM on Rocinha; residual built-up bias diagnostic | DTM comparison + license-vs-accuracy trade table | **GO** if at least one DTM beats raw-GLO-30 and DSM-as-DTM nulls on the >25° bin. Decide default (clean) vs NC variant. |
| **S3 — Vintage & CV plumbing** | 2019-vs-2023 change proxy; nested spatial-block CV on Rocinha sub-blocks | Change-flagged metrics; any offset fit on train folds only | **GO** if with/without-change footprint metrics diverge as expected and no tunable is fit on test. |
| **S4 — Scale to 5 sites** | Run S1–S3 across Rocinha, Vidigal, Maré, Alemão, Jacarezinho; leave-one-favela-out | Per-site × per-component × per-stratum master table + agreement plots | **GO** if per-fold CIs are reported and no single site's collapse is hidden by pooling. |
| **S5 — Portability check (optional)** | Score one favela *outside* the five to test generalization claims | Held-out-favela card | Substantiates or retracts any generalization claim; NC vs CC-BY variants both frozen. |

Commit predecessor work (harness, per-site cards) before launching any scaled GEE export, per the repo's long-running-job rule.

## 7. Risks & open questions

**Structural risks (physical, not fixable with free data):**
- **DTM/DSM separation is confounded on steep morros.** A 30 m cell on a 40–50% slope spans ~12–15 m of intra-cell terrain drop — larger than a favela rooftop — so nDSM per-building is noise and even bare-earth DTMs may leave contiguous self-built mass embedded, biasing terrain +2–6 m exactly at the evaluation sites. *Mitigation:* report the inside-favela residual bias diagnostic per site; never use nDSM per-building.
- **Instance under-segmentation is irreducible** at 4 m effective resolution against 5–8 m roofs. *Mitigation:* make the area-IoU−instance-F1 gap a first-class reported metric; headline on area/grid supports.
- **Per-building height saturation/compression** from Sentinel-2-derived 2.5D. *Mitigation:* the height-stratified bias curve exposes it explicitly; lead with grid-mean/volume aggregates, which is what morphometrics/CFD actually consume.

**Process risks:**
- **Leakage-by-calibration** — the pull to fit a global height/DTM offset against IPP to "improve" zero-shot. *Mitigation:* file-access quarantine + disjoint-fold-only fitting, enforced structurally, not by promise.
- **License drift** — pulling Microsoft/FABDEM into a claimed-CC-BY product silently contaminates it. *Mitigation:* two frozen variants; Microsoft/OSM as QA overlays only.

**Open questions:**
1. Does FathomDEM's ViT bare-earthing generalize to contiguous informal fabric, or does it under-remove and inflate terrain? (S2 answers per site.)
2. Is the OB 2.5D favela height bias closer to +overestimation (Global-North pattern) or −underestimation (low-rise compression)? No free local ground truth exists to correct it — the honest answer may be "unknown and uncorrectable within the free-data constraint."
3. How much of the footprint error is real 2015→2019/2023 change vs method error? The change proxy bounds it but cannot fully disentangle vertical growth.
4. Is a truly held-out sixth favela (S5) needed for any generalization claim, or is the deliverable explicitly scoped to "measured accuracy on these five, no generalization claimed"? Recommend the latter unless a reviewer demands otherwise.
5. Would DLR TanDEM-X 12 m EDEM (sharper DSM, science-proposal-gated, **not redistributable**) materially improve the nDSM anchor enough to justify the non-redistributable dependency? Default: no — keep it an optional non-shipped cross-check.

**Bottom line:** free EO can deliver a geometrically plausible 2.5D favela scene with an exact-2019 height layer and a defensible bare-earth DTM, but it *cannot* resolve individual rooftops or steep-slope micro-relief. The contribution is therefore an honest, leakage-guarded, favela-stratified benchmark of exactly where free data succeeds (aggregate height, built-up area, mean terrain) and where it structurally fails (per-building geometry, steep-slope DTM) — not a claim of per-building fidelity the physics forbids.
